pathway_name: Prebiotic Strecker synthesis of L-alanine from acetylene

reactions.name: Prebiotic acetylene hydration
reactions.mechanism: Nickel sulfide catalyzes the hydration of acetylene, producing acetaldehyde.

conditions.temperature: Approximately 105 degrees Celsius in a published experiment

reactions.evidence: Experimentally demonstrated under simulated prebiotic conditions.

reactions.name: Ammonia addition to acetaldehyde
reactions.mechanism: Nucleophilic addition of ammonia to the carbonyl carbon produces a carbinolamine.
reactions.evidence: The aminoalcohol intermediate was detected in a simulated prebiotic system.

reactions.name: Imine formation
reactions.mechanism: Dehydration of the carbinolamine produces an imine.

reactions.name: Cyanide addition producing S-aminonitrile
reactions.mechanism: Cyanide attacks the planar imine carbon from one face, generating the S enantiomer.
reactions.stereochemistry: One branch of a normally racemic reaction; no intrinsic preference for S.

reactions.name: Cyanide addition producing R-aminonitrile
reactions.mechanism: Cyanide attacks the opposite face of the planar imine, generating the R enantiomer.

reactions.name: Hydration of S-aminonitrile
reactions.mechanism: Hydrolysis of the nitrile group to a primary amide.

reactions.name: Hydration of R-aminonitrile
reactions.mechanism: Hydrolysis of the R-aminonitrile to the corresponding amide.

reactions.name: Formation of L-alanine
reactions.mechanism: Hydrolysis of the primary amide generates L-alanine and ammonia.
reactions.stereochemistry: The S configuration is retained if racemization is avoided.

reactions.name: Formation of D-alanine
reactions.mechanism: Hydrolysis of the R-alaninamide produces D-alanine.
reactions.stereochemistry: Competing branch yielding the D enantiomer.

prebiotic_plausibility.status: Experimentally supported route to alanine, with unresolved enantioselectivity
prebiotic_plausibility.explanation: Acetylene hydration over nickel sulfide, followed by Strecker chemistry, has been demonstrated in laboratory simulations of prebiotic environments. The reaction produces alanine without enzymes. Individual elementary intermediates and reaction conditions are not necessarily identical across all proposed stages.
prebiotic_plausibility.stereochemistry_limitation: Achiral Strecker synthesis produces approximately equal amounts of L-alanine and D-alanine. The pathway therefore produces L-alanine as part of a racemic mixture, not as an isolated enantiopure product.
prebiotic_plausibility.possible_l_enrichment: Circularly polarized ultraviolet light has produced small L-alanine enantiomeric excesses in experiments on extraterrestrial organic precursors. Applying such an enrichment mechanism to this specific Strecker network remains hypothetical.

references.title: Formation, stabilization and fate of acetaldehyde and higher aldehydes in an autonomously changing prebiotic system emerging from acetylene
Proton transfers in the Strecker reaction revealed by DFT calculations
Asymmetric synthesis of amino acid precursors in interstellar complex organics by circularly polarized light
